context: Formal algebra: nonzero polynomial in R[X] over a commutative unital ring
display_term: degree of a nonzero univariate polynomial

formulations.text: Let R be a commutative ring with multiplicative identity and let P=∑_{k=0}^n a_kX^k∈R[X] be nonzero. Its degree deg(P) is the greatest integer k≥0 for which a_k≠0_R. This definition does not assign a finite degree to the zero polynomial.

context: Classical real analysis: universal sufficiently fine tagged partition integral
display_term: proper Riemann integral on a compact interval

formulations.text: Let f:[a,b]→R be bounded with a<b. For a finite partition a=x_0<⋯<x_n=b and arbitrary tags ξ_i∈[x_{i−1},x_i], let S=Σ_{i=1}^n f(ξ_i)(x_i−x_{i−1}) and mesh=max_i(x_i−x_{i−1}). The function f is Riemann integrable on [a,b] with integral L∈R if for every ε>0 there exists δ>0 such that |S−L|<ε for every tagged partition with mesh<δ.

context: DLMF orthogonal-polynomial analysis: raw power moment with respect to a positive measure
display_term: nth raw moment of an orthogonality measure

formulations.text: Let μ be a nonnegative Borel or Lebesgue–Stieltjes measure on a real interval (a,b) and let n be a nonnegative integer such that x↦x^n is μ-integrable. The nth raw moment of μ is μ_n=∫_a^b x^n dμ(x). It is finite only when the integral is finite.
